ModelContextProtocol.AspNetCore - The library for HTTP-based MCP servers.
You can also browse the samples directory and the API documentation for more details on available functionality.
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol that standardizes how applications provide context to Large Language Models (LLMs).
It enables secure integration between LLMs and various data sources and tools.
